## #3 — Martin — 2006-10-13
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/966/post-6063>

Hi,
you probably want something like collision detection. But that is not possible via scripting. At least no yet. Sorry. Scripts would be also much to slow for that task. Normally you use a physics engine for that a job. But that is probably something for a full version Cheetah3D update since that is quite some work to integrate a physics engine.

Bye,
Martin
